chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when perfume was brought to him on the day of al-Fiṭr, would begin with his tongue.

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم do when perfume was brought to him on Eid al-Fitr?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم on the day of Eid al-Fitr when perfume was brought to him. It reflects a Prophetic sunnah connected to adornment and etiquette on a day of worship and celebration.
